name: travelling-wave-ballistic
description: Arithmetic, and exact: with the wave amplitude at zero every ring holds nothing and the flight is field-free, so the transit is 27 mm over the injection speed of 1500 m/s - 18.0 us to the last figure the integrator can carry. The control for travelling-wave-capture, which covers the same distance in 9.0 us because the wave carries it at twice its own speed.
